The arrangement was as pictured and arrived quickly! They even sent a picture before it was delivered.

products.name: Autumn Blaze
products.description: Ignite the spirit of the season with our "Autumn Blaze" Mixed Fall Flower Arrangement from A Beautiful California Florist in Long Beach!

products.name: Belmont
products.description: Sure to brighten anyone's day and bring smiles, joy and laughter. This arrangement is a collection of bright roses, pastel flowering stalk and premium accent blooms, lush greens in a clear vase.

products.name: Artisan Wrapped Bouquet
products.description: Beautifully wrapped assortment of colorful blooms chosen by our house Artisan/Florist will be made with todays fresh flowers delivered to us direct from the huge LA Flower Market.

products.name: The Emma
products.description: The Emma, a beautiful arrangement of pink roses, cymbidium orchid, hydrangea, verdant cremon, lisianthus and accented by lush wintergreens (which impart strength, vibrant health and luck in the New Year).

products.name: Autumn Pumpkin
products.description: Bring the beauty of fall indoors with this stunning autumn floral arrangement, perfect for the fall season and Thanksgiving centerpieces. A variety of fresh fall flowers are artfully arranged in a charming 7-inch ceramic pumpkin container.

products.name: Lovely You
products.description: Large size lush mix of pink lilies, red roses, and tall snapdragons in a pink textured glass vase, fuller height and volume with more flowers added.

products.name: Autumn Shades
products.description: The change of seasons is upon us. Autumn Shades in fall colors and textures burst forth in this beautiful Fall arrangement.

products.name: Box of Autumn
products.description: Wouldn’t life be more convenient if seasons came in boxes? We already have boxed wine, boxed lunches, and boxing matches. Seasons need to catch up. Now they have. Introducing the Box of Autumn.

products.name: Autumn Serenade
products.description: Bring the sweet music of fall into your home with our stunning Autumn Serenade arrangement. This exquisite floral bouquet is a true masterpiece, filled with the rich, vibrant colors of autumn.

products.name: Lavender Bag of Flowers
products.description: Soft lavender and white blooms spill from a lavender gift bag to create a romantic birthday bouquet or thoughtful just-because arrangement that feels both fresh and celebratory.

products.name: Long Beach Charms
products.description: A cluster of soft pink roses and pale pink alstroemeria creates a romantic, gently textured centerpiece perfect for a birthday bouquet, mother's day gift, anniversary flowers, or a thoughtful "I'm thinking of you" gift.

products.name: Premium Sunflowers Arrangement
products.description: A gorgeous display of premium sunflowers burst forth from an elegant ceramic vase accented by green satin ribbon. This is an impressive display and perfect gift for the sunflower lover in your life.

products.name: Wonderful World
products.description: "The colors of the rainbow So pretty in the sky Are also on the faces Of people going by I see friends shaking hands, saying, "How do you do?" They're really saying, "I love you" " - Louis Armstrong Wonderful World is an arrangement of…

products.name: Violets in Blue
products.description: A refined mix of white roses and lilies punctuated by vivid purple carnations, this flower arrangement-perfect as a sympathy arrangement or for a formal wedding-creates an immediate sense of calm and grace.

products.name: Enchanting
products.description: Vivid red roses paired with soft pink lilies create a romantic, celebratory bouquet made to make the person you're thinking of feel deeply adored.

products.name: Color My World
products.description: Stems of brightly colored premium roses, exotic blooms of pastel cymbidium orchids, blue star thistle, jewel toned carnations, all accented by lush Italian ruscus and set in white ceramic vase.

products.name: Lush Life
products.description: Lush Life This is a low and lush floral arrangement of pink and white roses, hydrangeas, orchids, and succulents. Arranged in a 6" clear cylinder vase, overall size is 13" T x 13" W.
